name: NVIDIA Hopper H800 documentation (vGPU reference)
notes: H800 is export-restricted; NVIDIA publishes no public datasheet with memory figures. SXM5 H800 uses the same 80 GB HBM3 / 3.35 TB/s memory subsystem as H100 SXM5 (H800 PCIe variant is 80 GB HBM2e, ~2 TB/s). Treated as 80 GB HBM3 @ 3,350 GB/s.
